inputSchema.description: Request schema for updating the state of a checklist item on a Trello card.

idCard.description: The ID or short link of the Trello card containing the checklist item.
idCard.title: Id Card

idCheckItem.description: The ID of the check item within the checklist whose state needs to be updated.
idCheckItem.title: Id Check Item

idChecklist.description: The ID of the checklist on the card that contains the check item to be updated.
idChecklist.title: Id Checklist

value.description: The new state for the check item. Use 'complete' or 'true' to mark as complete, and 'incomplete' or 'false' to mark as incomplete.
value.title: Value

inputSchema.title: UpdateCardsChecklistItemsStateByIdCardByIdChecklistByIdCheckItemRequest

UpdateCardsChecklistItemsStateByIdCardBy.description: Response schema for the updated checklist item state action.

due.description: The due date for the check item in ISO 8601 format (e.g., '2021-02-12T07:00:00.000Z'). Requires Business Class or higher. May be null.
due.title: Due

dueReminder.description: The number of seconds before the due date to send a reminder. Requires Business Class or higher. May be null.
dueReminder.title: Due Reminder

id.description: The unique identifier (TrelloID) of the check item.
id.title: Id

idChecklist.description: The ID (TrelloID) of the parent checklist containing this check item.
idChecklist.title: Id Checklist

idMember.description: The ID (TrelloID) of the member assigned to this check item. Requires Business Class or higher. May be null.
idMember.title: Id Member

name.description: The text/title of the check item.
name.title: Name

nameData.description: Additional data related to the check item name. Typically null.
nameData.title: Name Data

pos.description: The position of the check item within the checklist, used for ordering.
pos.title: Pos

state.description: The completion state of the check item. Can be 'complete' or 'incomplete'.
state.title: State

UpdateCardsChecklistItemsStateByIdCardBy.title: UpdateCardsChecklistItemsStateByIdCardByIdChecklistByIdCheckItemResponse
